unit: Algebra · Chapter 5. Continuity and the derivative
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: The derivative of f'(x) is the second derivative f''(x); e.g. f = x⁴ gives f' = 4x³ and f'' = 12x².
stages.headlineEnglish: The derivative of f'(x) is the second derivative f''(x); e.g. f = x⁴ gives f' = 4x³ and f'' = 12x².

stages.headline: Mechanically, if s(t) is distance then s''(t) is acceleration: s = 5t² gives v = 10t and a = 10.
stages.headlineEnglish: Mechanically, if s(t) is distance then s''(t) is acceleration: s = 5t² gives v = 10t and a = 10.

stages.headline: If f'(x₀) = 0 and f''(x₀) > 0, x₀ is a minimum point; if f''(x₀) < 0, a maximum point.
stages.headlineEnglish: If f'(x₀) = 0 and f''(x₀) > 0, x₀ is a minimum point; if f''(x₀) < 0, a maximum point.
